# Carbon vs affordability tables (generated by scripts/11_bill_constraint.py)

Model-based estimates (simulated demand x realised average CI; simulated bills). bill_change = mean household bill vs historical TOU in the same test window. Deployable cap = (1 + x) x reference price paid (historical TOU over train+val). pred_paid / sim_paid = mean daily price paid (p/kWh) with decision-time / simulated demand. matched_* = retrospective cap relative to the test window's own historical TOU (not deployable).
